Everything looks clean. Here's a summary of what was done:

**[TextMessage.tsx](src/screens/room/fragments/text-message/TextMessage.tsx)**
- Renamed to `TextMessageInner`, wrapped in `memo` with the same key-based comparator as `SingleMessageType`. Now even if `SingleMessageTypeInner` re-renders, `TextMessage` bails out unless the event key changes, `isPreviousSameSender` changes, or the event is a new reference with actual content updates.

**[RoomTimeline.tsx](src/screens/room/fragments/room-timeline/RoomTimeline.tsx)**
- `handleScrollDown`, `handleOnScroll`, `handleContentSizeChange` — all wrapped in `useCallback`
- `keyExtractor` extracted into a stable `useCallback` and passed by reference to `FlashList`

This removes the three new function references FlashList was receiving on every scroll-triggered re-render, reducing how often it re-invokes `renderItem` in the first place.
